description.value: Island Lake Lodge is a world-class backcountry mountain resort near Fernie, B.C., comprising three timber-frame lodges — Tamarack, Cedar, and Red Eagle — with 26 guest rooms set within 7,000 acres of wilderness in the Lizard Range. Famous for legendary catskiing in winter, the property opens for summer stays from mid-June to mid-September, offering a spa, gourmet dining, guided hikes, and foraging experiences. The lodge operates off-grid with no TVs or fridges in guestrooms, though WiFi and cell service are available throughout.
